name: Seltz
description: Seltz MCP provides real-time web search and content extraction for AI agents. Seltz runs its own crawl-to-retrieval stack purpose-built for LLMs — search the live web and fresh news, extract complete page content from any URL, and give Claude accurate, current information beyond its training data, without the noise of consumer search results.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Seltz to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Seltz to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.seltz.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Seltz MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seltz provides these MCP tools: search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Seltz?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Seltz in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Seltz requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Seltz is developed by Seltz. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
